title: Store Credit, Loyalty Points and Referrals | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The customers who come back are worth rewarding. CrestApps lets you give store credit by hand or as a refund, reward every order with loyalty points, and give each customer a referral link that rewards them when a friend places a first order, with each one spent at checkout after tax and followed in the buyer's account.

In this video:
• Why reward customers, and how credit, points and referrals fit together
• Giving store credit on a customer's page, and refunding as store credit
• Using store credit at checkout and in My account
• The loyalty points program and a customer's points
• Spending points at checkout
• Setting up referrals: what a friend gets and what the customer gets
• The referral link, the friend and the reward
